sourceLanguage.description: BCP 47 tag; omit to let the provider detect it

endDate.description: Present exactly when startDate is present, never before it

TripAlert.description: Structured alert; clients render copy from titleCode and messageData

TripInput.description: Ownership comes from the authenticated principal, never from the body.

nextCursor.description: Present only when hasMore is true

TripPatch.description: Omitted fields are unchanged. destinationId and originAirport accept explicit null to clear. startDate and endDate are changed together: both dates or both null.

accessToken.description: Short-lived bearer credential for every product operation.

expiresAt.description: When the access token stops being accepted.

refreshToken.description: Single-use. Each refresh returns a new one; presenting a used one revokes the whole session family.

authorizationCode.description: The single-use Sign in with Apple authorization code, so tokens can be revoked when the account is deleted.

identityToken.description: A verified identity credential, such as the Sign in with Apple identity token. It is exchanged once for a NUVRO session and never reused as a bearer credential.

purgeAfter.description: The instant after which stored data is erased. Access ends immediately at request time.

reason.description: Optional short reason, chosen from a fixed list in the client, never free text about a person.

authorizationCode.description: The single-use authorization code from ASAuthorizationAppleIDCredential, exchanged server side for a refresh token that is stored sealed and revoked when the account is deleted.

bearerAuth.description: A Sign in with Apple identity token for the configured NUVRO audience. The backend verifies signature, issuer, audience and expiry against Apple's published keys, then resolves or enrols the NUVRO account behind that identity. Development builds may accept an explicitly configured development credential instead; see docs/api/authentication.md.
